𝐈𝐬𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐭:As part of the government's efforts to combat the declining birthrate, two brothers and sisters are forced to have children.
They've been close for years, like brother and sister. Until they can have a child, they're trapped on an island with no entertainment options. They gradually run out of things to do, and slowly begin to notice each other.
At first, it was just a simple brother-sister flirtation, but things get out of hand...‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎𝐕𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐭:Once again, a brother and sister are forced to have children as part of the government's efforts to combat the declining birthrate... but this time there are three! But will they only impregnate one?
But to his sisters, their brother is nothing more than a jack-of-all-trades. Things aren't going to be that way...
After years of being bullied by his sisters, the brother finally reaches his limit. The long-standing power balance between the three is easily shattered by the overwhelming power of his male penis ... Which of these two sisters' onaholes will he impregnate? What will the answer be? 60 pages. Edited with both mosaics and blackouts. This is part of a series, but it's not a direct sequel, so you can enjoy this one on its own.
